Metadata.title: GoToUSA
Metadata.description: Your companion on the journey to prepare for living in the United States.

Welcome.eyebrow: Your journey to the United States
Welcome.title: Moving to another country is a journey. Let's walk it together.
Welcome.intro: Visas, money and housing matter, but they are only part of the path. Preparation comes first: language, culture, finances, family and the right place for you. GoToUSA helps you see the whole picture and follow your progress, step by step.

you.title: You lead the journey
you.body: GoToUSA is your guide: it shows the tasks, explains, reminds and celebrates with you. But you are always the one who decides and acts.

whole.title: See the whole path
whole.body: It is a long journey, with effort and trade-offs. Seeing everything organized from the start helps you keep going when things get hard.

decide.title: Deciding is also a win
decide.body: If along the way you realize it is not for you, that is okay. What matters is making a conscious decision, for the right reasons.

data.title: Your data stays with you
data.body: Your answers are saved only in this browser. Clearing the browser deletes everything, but you will be able to download your journey to keep it.

Welcome.importLink: Already have a downloaded journey? Import it here

Disclaimer.title: Important notice
Disclaimer.body1: GoToUSA supports your journey. It is not a legal service and does not provide legal advice.
Disclaimer.body2: The information shown is compiled from official U.S. sources, but mistakes can happen when summarizing. Each piece of content links to the full official source.
Disclaimer.body3: For decisions about your situation, always check the official source or talk to an immigration attorney or a specialist.
Disclaimer.checkbox: I have read and understand that GoToUSA is not a legal service.

Family.title: Your family
Family.intro: A summary built only from your answers. Tap "Change answer" to adjust; everything is recalculated right away.
Family.ageToday: {age, plural, one {# year} other {# years}} old today
Family.singleIncome: At first, only one person plans to work in the U.S. It's worth planning a larger cushion and checking with a professional whether other adults will be able to work under the visa.
Family.pathsIntro: Based on your answers, these paths are worth exploring. It's a direction, not an evaluation: an immigration attorney evaluates your case.
Family.noPaths: No path stands out yet. That's a result too: start by learning about the possibilities.
Family.missingBlocks: Answer these sections to see other paths that may fit you:

Family.whyShownHint: These answers led to this path. They don't confirm that a petition will be approved.
Family.lawyerBody: GoToUSA supports your journey; it is not legal advice. Your case should be evaluated, and the legal process handled, by an immigration attorney or a qualified professional.

More.title: More
More.dataIntro: In the free mode, your answers and progress stay only in this browser, with nothing on our server. If you clear your browser data or switch devices, they are lost. So download your journey from time to time.
More.unreadable: Some data in this browser is in a format we can't read. Nothing was deleted. You can import a file you downloaded before.
More.downloadBody: Creates a file with your answers and progress, to keep or open on another device.

More.downloaded: File downloaded. Keep it somewhere safe.
More.privacy: The file contains your answers, including about health and money. Keep it somewhere safe and don't share it. It has no documents or passwords.
More.importBody: Open a file downloaded from GoToUSA (from another device or from before) to pick up where you left off.

Account.title: My account
Account.intro: With an account, your family will be able to follow the journey with you (coming soon).
Account.journeyStays: Your journey stays saved on this device. It will be able to move to your account in a later step.
Account.signedOut: You signed out on this device.
Account.verified: Email confirmed! Your account is ready.
Account.name: What should we call you?
Account.nameHint: Your first name or a nickname is fine.
Account.passwordHint: 8 to 128 characters. An easy-to-remember phrase works well.
Account.dataNote: Your account only keeps your name, email, language, your protected password (never the password itself) and access details (device and network address), used to keep your account safe.
Account.legalNote: Reminder: GoToUSA supports your journey and does not give legal advice, as stated in the legal notice you accepted.
Account.haveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in
Account.checkBody: If this email can be used, we sent you a confirmation link. Open it to activate your account.
Account.checkHint: The link is valid for 1 hour. Didn't get it? Check your spam folder.
Account.forgotBody: Enter your account email. We'll send you a link to create a new password.
Account.forgotSent: If there is an account with this email, we sent a link to create a new password.
Account.resetNote: When you save, you'll be signed out on your other devices.
Account.resetDone: Password changed! Now just sign in with your new password.
Account.deleteBody: Deletes your account and all sign-ins. The journey saved on this device stays here.
Account.deleteStart: I want to delete my account
Account.deleted: Account deleted. Your journey is still saved on this device.
